task: FV2-035 / FV2-009 — selected remote screen thumbnail in the Flutter sharing rail
summary: A paired screen-share run showed that the Flutter main viewer rendered a remote stream while its selected screen-sharing rail card still showed the publisher avatar. The cause was that temporary thumbnail capture intentionally skips the currently selected participant, while the persistent TrackSubscribed path did not start a replacement capture. The selected remote screen now captures a bounded thumbnail after subscription; temporary preview subscriptions are excluded to avoid duplicate capture.

checks.name: Flutter selected-screen capture policy regression
checks.observation: The new policy test first failed because the selected-subscription policy did not exist. After implementation it passes for selected remote screen video and rejects audio, non-video, unselected and other-participant subscriptions. Existing capture-pipeline and rail rendering/geometry tests also pass.

checks.name: Selected remote thumbnail paired visual retest before hot reload
checks.observation: The already-running macOS Debug client displayed the moving Android stream in its main viewer, but the selected rail card still rendered the publisher avatar. The UI process was running build 1.0.29+43, so this screenshot did not exercise the latest working-tree fix.

checks.name: macOS hot reload and in-place session recovery
checks.observation: DevTools connected to the existing macOS Debug app and reported Hot reload completed. The app then returned to startup; after its bounded wait it showed `Не удалось проверить сессию`. The visible `Повторить подключение` action was tried once and reached the same timeout. No Keychain prompt appeared and no password was entered. A post-fix paired thumbnail screenshot could not be obtained until the existing Mac session is restored.

checks.name: Android local thumbnail and projection cleanup
checks.observation: While the Android sender was foregrounded, its own screen-sharing rail showed a captured local thumbnail. The Android test share was stopped with the in-app control and `adb shell dumpsys media_projection` reported `null`; the client remained in SHARE_TEST with its microphone unavailable/disabled. This does not verify the remote Mac thumbnail.

checks.name: Spec traceability verifier
checks.observation: PowerShell Core (pwsh) is not installed on this host.

limitations: Selected remote thumbnail rendering after this fix still needs a paired visual runtime check after the existing macOS session recovers. The in-place Retry did not recover it; no login credential or Keychain password was entered.
Windows build and runtime acceptance were not part of this focused Flutter Mac/Android follow-up.
